description: Turn the signed-in person's monthly re-scans of their sites on or off, and the email of each result on or off. Leave a field out to keep it as it is; call with no fields to read the current settings. The settings belong to the account, not to one site.

email.description: Email the person the result of each monthly re-scan. Leave out to keep the current setting.

rescan.description: Re-scan this account's sites automatically each month. Leave out to keep the current setting.

name: set_rescan_settings
title: Set monthly re-scans
